mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the mean return in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1900 thousand units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 109.5 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the mean return in low-INDPRO periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential construction starts signals broad-based demand strength, which drives corporate earnings optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI and a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the central bank to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures and a rise in residential construction starts signals robust household demand, which drives corporate revenue expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
